From: finance@safehealth.io <finance@safehealth.io>

Subject: Re: Clarify APAC GST withholding and self-bill routing for SafeHealth invoice

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear note and attachments. Quick answers from APAC AP team: 

- SafeHealth prefers vendors to provide a self-billed invoice (we process vendor self-bills weekly). That avoids our AP team needing to re-create supplier invoices.
- For Australia (we are AU-entity payer), we are required to withhold 2% GST on certain cross-border service arrangements when the supplier does not have an Australian ABN on file. If Redwood can provide an Australian ABN or accept self-bill with our ABN referenced, we will not create a withholding. If no ABN, we will withhold 2% and supply a tax certificate.
- For Singapore and NZ we have separate local rules; we will not generally withhold GST in SG if a local GST registration exists for the supplier, but we do perform an entity check.

Attached: a sample self-bill template completed by our AP test account. We also included the withholding certificate format.

Please confirm: 1) which Redwood legal entity we should reference on the self-bill for AU payments; 2) whether Redwood can provide ABN / GST registration details for that entity; 3) if Redwood wants SafeHealth to include a withheld line or to issue supplier invoice instead.

Regards,
Maya Chen
Head of AP Operations (SafeHealth)
finance@safehealth.io

Jasmine / Marcus —

Quick update after one call with Consult Group APAC (copied). Short answer: we should accept self-bill for this account but require SafeHealth to reference the Redwood AU branch/ABN pair. Options: 

1) If Redwood has an existing AU-registered entity with ABN (Redwood Inference Pty Ltd) we invoice from that entity. Provide ABN to SafeHealth and no withholding applies. We have that entity on record but need confirmation that the billing/legal ops team can route the invoice to that entity for this contract. Pros: no withholding, cleaner VAT/GST treatment. Cons: may require contract amendment to route revenue to that AU entity. 

2) If we cannot route to AU entity immediately, allow SafeHealth self-bill but require they include our ABN in their self-bill template (they can reference it if we provide it). If we still don’t have ABN on file, they will withhold 2% and supply a certificate that Finance can claim back if applicable. 

Recommendation: route this customer to Redwood Inference Pty Ltd for AU payments and provide ABN to SafeHealth. Marcus — can you confirm whether there are any material tax or transfer pricing concerns for routing revenue for this customer to AU for the size of the contract (sub-$500k ARR)? If clean, I’ll ask Legal to process a quick addendum to state invoicing entity.

Action items: 
- Marcus: quick sign-off on routing to AU entity (yes/no) by 18:00 UTC.
- Jasmine: hold response to SafeHealth until we confirm entity; if timing tight, request they accept self-bill with ABN referenced and confirm withholding certificate process.
- Ben: I’ll coordinate with Legal for addendum if needed.

Thanks —
